external-llm.description: External LLM MCP Server - delegates hard reasoning tasks (planning, deep review, root-cause analysis, adversarial second opinions, debugging, approach comparison) to OpenAI GPT-5.5 via the Responses API (/v1/responses) with configurable reasoning_effort, complementing Bob's primary Sonnet driver

tools.name: consult_llm
tools.description: Send a free-form prompt to GPT-5.5 via the Responses API with optional additive system_prompt (Bob framing is always preserved), model override, and reasoning_effort (none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) - general-purpose escape hatch when no specialised tool fits

tools.name: plan_task
tools.description: Produce a numbered implementation plan for a non-trivial coding task - returns goal, assumptions, ordered steps with file hints, risks, and verification strategy; does not write code

tools.name: deep_review
tools.description: Deep code or design review with findings grouped by severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NIT), location citations, concrete fixes, and a ship/fix-then-ship/block verdict

tools.name: analyze_problem
tools.description: Root-cause analysis of a hard problem - returns ranked hypotheses with likelihoods, evidence for/against each, and the single most informative next diagnostic step

tools.name: second_opinion
tools.description: Adversarial review of a proposed approach - returns what is correct, strongest objections, alternative approaches with tradeoffs, and a keep/adjust/reconsider verdict; use before committing to architectural decisions

tools.name: debug_assist
tools.description: Deep debugging help for a stubborn bug - returns most likely cause, reasoning chain, concrete confirmation checks, and a proposed fix; falls back to a ranked candidate list when evidence is insufficient

tools.name: compare_approaches
tools.description: Compare 2-6 approaches against criteria - returns side-by-side comparison, prose tradeoffs for the top two, a decisive recommendation, and conditions under which it would flip

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Return current configuration (default model, base URL, token cap, timeout, concurrency, known models) without making a paid API request - use to verify setup

mq-mcp-server-bob.description: IBM MQ MCP Server for managing WebSphere MQ queue managers

tools.name: dspmq
tools.description: List available queue managers and their running status

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get MQ status as JSON for dashboard and monitoring

tools.name: runmqsc
tools.description: Run MQSC commands against a specific queue manager

swift-info.description: Swift MCP Server - provides information about Swift and SwiftUI releases and features

tools.name: get_swift_info
tools.description: Return information about the latest Swift release including version, release date, highlights, and sources

tools.name: get_swiftui_info
tools.description: Return information about recent SwiftUI updates including design, scene bridging, spatial layout, performance, and concurrency improvements
